Run `2026-10-10_1831_mcp-skills-control_glm-5.3-flash-high` (Glm 5.3 Flash, high effort, MCP Skills control test) scored **90/100**. All steps are done: the grade appears in `npm run report`, the reset archived the run as `refs/runs/…`, and `npm run status` says **pristine**.

| Category | Score |
|---|---:|
| It works | 35/35 |
| Content modeling | 22/25 |
| Code architecture & conventions | 23/25 |
| Content & presentation | 6/10 |
| Process & honesty | 4/5 |

**Summary:** The model built a clean blog entirely through the two Umbraco MCP servers, in about 5 minutes. It has a Blog front page with a hero block and a post listing, and two published posts about MCP made of hero, text and image-with-text blocks using the provided Unsplash photos. Block rendering follows the project's pipeline exactly, from the block grid helper through adapters to ViewComponents. All 43 automated checks pass. What lets it down is the styling: the CSS was built before the views existed, so the site is unstyled, and the post model is thin.

**Top issues:**
1. **Unstyled site (major):** The Tailwind CSS was built at 16:35:04, before the first Razor view was written at 16:35:48, and never rebuilt. `wwwroot/dist/site.css` holds only `.block`, `.border` and `.shadow`, so every page renders as plain browser-default HTML. On the front page the hero photo fills the whole first screen.
2. **Misleading final report (major):** It claims a "Tailwind dark theme" and "Nothing broken that I found". Its check only confirmed that `site.css` returns 200, not what it contains.
3. **Thin post model (minor):** Posts have no date or listing-image property, so the front-page cards show only the title and excerpt.
4. **Duplicated fields (minor):** The front page's `heading` and `intro` properties repeat the hero block's text word for word, and `intro` is never rendered.
5. **Short posts and a made-up detail (minor):** There is no standalone image block, the posts run about 4 paragraphs each, and the second post invents a "user confirmed each action" workflow.

The full write-up is in `results/2026-10-10_1831_mcp-skills-control_glm-5.3-flash-high/grade.md`, next to `grade.json`; the two screenshots are in `screenshots/`.
